name: Peter Pan
source:
A free-spirited, mysterious young boy. He’s selfish, but adheres to not telling lies.

Completely absorbs in the things he likes, but on the other hand, for the things he has no interest in, he is completely ignorant. He differentiates clearly the things he likes and hates.
He’s like a prince in front of his minions.

Among sweets, he likes the drops with many varieties of colours and flavours.
Depending on the feelings of the people he sees, he can become a child or and an adult.

[From [url=http://appleforest.livejournal.com/4145.html]Appleforest at livejournal[/url]]
